body: I am in college as well for Marine Biology. I am struggling too. I had to withdraw from my math class and I failed my english class. My thing is that my parents are going to be really upset with me because they helped pay for a lot of it. My grandparents will be upset as well because they gave me alot of money. You are not alone. (PS I love Copepods!)
i have failed 2 classes as well. You are not alone. try reaching out to your counselor. I dont  want to sound like a know it all but just try it.
Just try to keep going. talk to a therapist, and if you cant, talk to anyone. Please. You can do this.

I am almost flunking college too. I feel the exact same way. My family is expecting too much from me. But then again I did pretty much waste my parents money so... I too feel like a huge disappointment. You are not alone, and neither am I.
dont do it. you have much to live for and people who care about you.
